## AI Inbox Triage Starter (drafts-only)

1. Gmail Trigger polls for unread mail
2. LLM classifies: urgent / lead / invoice / newsletter / other
3. urgent + lead + invoice get an AI **draft** reply
4. Nothing is auto-sent - a human reviews every draft
5. A daily digest summarizes everything

Swap the LLM base URL for OpenAI, Groq, or Gemini (OpenAI-compatible).
Done-for-you version: https://calendly.com/skynetlabs/schedule-a-free-consultation
